content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin HTW Foundation HTW Foundation: Preparation for your Studies in Germany Are you coming from abroad and want to study in Germany? But you don't yet meet all the language requirements for studying in Germany? Then the fee-based HTW Foundation courses offer you the perfect preparation for your Bachelor’s or Master’s degree — including personal advice and support on choosing a degree program, applying, and preparing for your studies.
